name: Yokai City
source:
Yokai City is a character-driven visual novel in the style of Japanese anime of the 1980s, set against a backdrop of uneasy social tensions between humans and yokai who are forced to live together in a part of Tokyo.

The year is 1988. After millennia of conflict with humans, all remaining yokai were at last convinced to relocate to the centre of Sumida: one of the capital’s 23 wards. Only oni and Inari remain now, all the other species of yokai that once played such an important part in Japan’s history and folklore are now reduced to existing solely in literature and cinema.

Enter the shoes of a half-man, half-oni regulator (a law enforcement official tasked with keeping the peace between humans and non-humans) and see how you and your team deal with daily life in 80s Tokyo all the while trying to stop criminals and violent fanatics from both sides who seem hell-bent on tearing the city apart.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2725430/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《妖怪城》是一部以角色为主导的视觉小说，采用20世纪80年代的日本动漫风格，背景是人类和妖怪被迫在东京的某个地区共同生活，社会关系紧张。

时间是1988年。在与人类进行了数千年的冲突之后，所有剩余的妖怪最终被说服搬迁到墨田区的中心：首都的23个区之一。现在只剩下鬼和稻荷，所有其他曾经在日本历史和民间传说中扮演重要角色的妖怪现在都只存在于文学和电影中。

扮演半人半鬼的监管者（负责维护人类与非人类之间和平的执法官员），看看你和你的团队如何应对80年代东京的日常生活，同时努力阻止双方的罪犯和暴力狂热分子，他们似乎一心想要撕裂这座城市。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2725430/]Steam[/url]]
